domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or domestic contract record was retrieved. Corporate site (https://www.merillife.com/about-us) states only: "Founded in 2006, Meril is a global medical device company... More than 150 countries served successfully around the globe. 35+ owned subsidiaries" and "Meril manufactures medical solutions in the form of vascular intervention devices, orthopedic implants, robotics, endo-surgery, ENT products, and in-vitro diagnostics" — this is a company self-description, not a supply record. No India-market shipment, invoice, tender or GST filing evidence was found in the sources reachable (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down, so GeM/CPPP could not be queried).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs rows with destination, HS code and B/L numbers exist (Japan, Colombia, 2026-02-28), plus recurring named foreign buyers in Italy, Turkey, Russia, Spain — this is a genuine manufacturer-exporter, not a paper trader. Domestic (India) supply side is NOT confirmed: only the company's own website claims manufacturing and a 150-country footprint; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or domestic contract could be retrieved, so domestic_status = declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read, not estimated. HS note: declared codes 300610/901890/902190 are broadly consistent with observed actual codes 30066030 (IUD/contraceptive) and 90183210 (suture needles); the observed customs codes should be treated as the factual HS set, with 30066030 and 90183210 added. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is wrong — actual activity is medical devices / surgical sutures and implants; this is a classification error, not a rejection ground. No rejection basis found (entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-28).
